name: Laser-sniper
description: The laser-sniper was a type of black sniper rifle that fired lasers. It had a scope that provided a red tinted crosshair. Shortly after the Battle of Yavin that marked the start of 0 ABY, the bounty hunter Glunge made use of a laser-sniper while attempting to claim a bounty on the smuggler Han Solo on the Outer Rim planet Rion.
